text:
anna-support: Customer reported big latency spikes and unexpected cross-region billing this morning. They say requests keep bouncing between eu-central-1 and us-west-2 and their costs jumped.
lee-eng: Can you paste a sample request id and approximate timestamps? We can trace routing. :mag:
anna-support: req id `rwd-req-01ab23cd`, seen at 2026-03-15T09:12:03Z and 2026-03-15T09:12:08Z. Customer uses our JS SDK v1.14.0 with hedgedRequests enabled.
sam-client: I looked at the SDK client config they sent:
```
const client = new Redwood({
  apiKey: process.env.RWD_KEY,
  hedgedRequests: { enabled: true, hedges: 2, hedgeDelayMs: 40 },
  retry: { maxRetries: 4, baseBackoffMs: 100 },
  regionPreference: 'local' // they thought this would stick
});
```
marta-ml: That `hedgeDelayMs: 40` plus aggressive backoff can trigger concurrent hedges to different endpoints if the routing table changes or if failover policy returns different fallback regions.
ops-oncall: Logs for `rwd-req-01ab23cd` show this pattern:
```
09:12:03 incoming from 10.4.2.17 region=eu-central-1
09:12:03 routed->eu-central-1/slot-7
09:12:03 client timed out waiting for kv cache hit
09:12:03 hedge#1 dispatched->us-west-2/slot-3
09:12:08 original completed->eu-central-1
09:12:09 hedge#1 also completed->us-west-2
```
anna-support: So both original and hedge completed — double charge for token compute and extra latency when two responses race.
lee-eng: This is classic hedged spurt behavior when hedges are allowed to go to any region fallback. We should ensure hedges prefer the same routing decision or are cancelled when original completes.
sam-client: SDK currently cancels in-flight hedges on response in most cases, but if the original request is slow to ack and the hedge is already routed to a different region before cancellation arrives, both can execute. Network jitter + our routing TTL causes different region selection.
marta-ml: Quick repro steps for eng:
1) Run SDK with hedgedRequests enabled, hedgeDelayMs <= 50
2) Force a slow kv/cache lookup on preferred region (~50-120ms)
3) Update routing table (simulate slot eviction) between original and hedge
4) Observe two completions and doubled billing for that token window
ops-oncall: Repro log snippet attached from customer (sanitized):
```
[client] sending original->eu-central-1
[client] after 41ms sending hedge->us-west-2
[routing] eu-central-1 slot moved to draining
[eu] finish 200 180ms
[us] finish 200 120ms
```
raghu-billing: Billing thread: hedges that complete count fully. If both complete, they billed both GPU tokens. We can offer refund if we confirm duplicate billable work.
anna-support: Customer wants a short-term mitigation and a long-term fix.
lee-eng: Short-term: advise customer to set `hedgedRequests.enabled = false` or set `allowCrossRegionHedging: false` (we don't expose that flag yet) and increase `hedgeDelayMs` to 200ms. That reduces simultaneous executions.
sam-client: I can push a patch to the SDK to add `hedgeRoutingPolicy: 'prefer_same'` — behavior: pick same route as original where possible, and immediately cancel outstanding hedges on first byte ack. Quick fix will be in v1.14.2.
marta-ml: Long-term: router should return a stable hedge-target for a request id (sticky fallback) for the hedge window, so hedges can't pick a wildly different region if slot movement occurs within the hedgeDelay.
ops-oncall: For this customer's account, we flipped a routing setting to prefer local region and increased route cache TTL to 15s. That should reduce region oscillation. Also disabled hedges for their API key temporarily.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: sdk@1.14.2 -> canary
lee-eng: Can someone reproduce with our test harness? Use this command:
```
./tools/hedge-test --sdk-version=1.14.0 --hedge-delay=40 --simulate-slot-eviction
```
sam-client: I ran it locally, reproduced, and opened PR #4723 with the `hedgeRoutingPolicy` option + earlier cancellation hook.
anna-support: Customer replied: "thanks, turning hedges off lowered our bills immediately, but we need the latency safety net. We'll test the new SDK flag when available." :slightly_smiling_face:
raghu-billing: I'll prepare refund proposal for duplicated completed hedges between 09:00-12:00 UTC for that account and route to CS for approval.
ops-oncall: Follow-ups: add telemetry counters for "double-complete" hedged requests, and an alert if >0.1% of requests in a minute have multiple completions.
lee-eng: Agreed. Also update docs: note that hedging may increase billing if both responses finish; best to use hedges with `hedgeDelayMs` tuned to typical host latencies.
anna-support: I'll send customer the mitigation steps and ETA for SDK patch (ETA: 48h for canary, 5d for stable). Closing once refund decision is made.
deploy-bot: Canaries started for sdk@1.14.2 at 1862345790
sam-client: PR merged to canary, monitoring.
ops-oncall: Marking action items: 1) telemetry + alert, 2) routing sticky fallback window, 3) SDK flag rollout, 4) customer refund review.
anna-support: Thanks everyone. :pray:
